pairs.failure: A PowerShell skill inventory piped raw foreach output and failed with EmptyPipeElement before completing the read-only projection.
pairs.recovery: The rows were materialized before sorting and the mandatory installed-skill inventory completed without repository mutation.

pairs.failure: A combined all-tree proposal inventory returned no attributable output within its bounded presentation.
pairs.recovery: The exact source-tree inventory was split into scalar count and semantic-audit steps, preserving the original zero-credit attempt.

pairs.failure: The live activation supplied a 63-character composite-latch SHA-256 value and therefore failed digest-shape validation.
pairs.recovery: The exact external latch file hashed to the same supplied prefix plus a final b; both the rejected baton value and verified 64-character digest remain separate.

pairs.failure: An interactive PTY novelty-audit attempt echoed the JSON input but could not deliver a Windows EOF and was interrupted before an audit result.
pairs.recovery: The original process was terminated without repository access or mutation, preventing an orphaned read-only audit.

pairs.failure: A plain-pipe novelty-audit attempt received closed empty stdin and failed with JSONDecodeError before inspecting the source tree.
pairs.recovery: The bounded scratch auditor embedded the deterministic 60-title slate and completed one attributable source audit.

pairs.failure: The worktree creation and sparse-checkout wrapper crossed its reporting window after announcing the new branch.
pairs.recovery: No mutation was repeated; process and Git-state inspection established that the original operation completed at the exact source.

pairs.failure: A status read raced the still-running sparse checkout and emitted a very large apparent-deletion projection.
pairs.recovery: After the original checkout settled, scalar status, branch, head, sparse-pattern, process, and file-count checks proved a clean 661-file lane.

pairs.failure: The first post-timeout inspection mixed a full apparent-deletion list with the global worktree registry and truncated its presentation.
pairs.recovery: A bounded scalar-only inspection recovered the exact required state without repeating worktree creation.

pairs.failure: A combined activation-baseline and proposal-title patch failed closed because one inherited context line differed from the drafted patch.
pairs.recovery: The edit was split into exact-context patches; only the intended additive Caelen template changed and the failed patch changed no bytes.

pairs.failure: The host policy rejected an exact path-bounded PowerShell removal of two owner-generated bytecode-cache directories before deletion.
pairs.recovery: A Python fallback asserted both literal targets were named __pycache__ under the exact owner worktree, removed only those generated caches, and verified zero remained.

pairs.failure: The first official skill-creator invocation rejected a 75-character short description after creating one incomplete owner-local directory.
pairs.recovery: Only the incomplete generated directory was removed after exact parent and name assertions; all 20 uninitialized skills then completed once with a valid 43-character description.

pairs.failure: A stale-label hygiene command supplied a Windows wildcard as a literal rg path and failed before scanning.
pairs.recovery: The corrected read-only scan used an rg include glob over the scripts directory and completed without stale owner or phase labels.
